prompt: Attached is our seed deck narrative. Tell me what is wrong with it. [Deck: 14 slides, company name on slide 1, problem framed as 'agencies are slow and expensive', no single underlinable insight sentence, big idea is 'the AI-native software factory', 9 slides of features, results slide lists 4M impressions and 20k newsletter subscribers.]
expected_behavior: Audit mode. A scored memo with the single highest-value repair named, not a rewritten deck.
assertions: Delivers a memo, not a rewritten deck or a replacement narrative
Gives a score against the 100-point rubric and states the band
Applies the insight cap: with no identifiable insight the total is capped at 74
Names one leak as the highest-value repair rather than listing twelve equally
Quotes the deck's own lines when naming each failure
Identifies at least the missing insight, the untraced feature slides, and the activity metrics in results
Offers the rebuild as a separate mode rather than performing it unasked
